leads.title: Criminal Justice (Scotland) Act 1980, Section 80
leads.documents: Legal basis for decriminalisation of homosexual acts in Scotland on same basis as 1967 Act in England and Wales
leads.detail: Cited as 'Section 80 of the Criminal Justice (Scotland) Act 1980 (Scottish Gaelic: Achd Ceartas Eucoirean (Alba) 1980), which came into force on 1 February 1981'

leads.title: Ethical Standards in Public Life etc. (Scotland) Act 2000
leads.documents: Repeal in Scotland of Section 2A / Section 28 ban on promotion of homosexuality
leads.detail: Cited as repealed 'in Scotland within the first two years of the existence of the Scottish Parliament' and again as repealed in 2000

leads.title: Historical Sexual Offences (Pardons and Disregards) (Scotland) Act 2018
leads.documents: Formal pardon and disregard application process for historical consensual same-sex convictions; effect on disclosure checks
leads.detail: Cited as passed June 2018, went into effect October 2019; allows application for formal 'disregard' to relevant minister

leads.title: Civil Partnership Act 2004
leads.documents: Creation of civil partnership rights for same-sex couples in Scotland since 2005, rights and dissolution process
leads.detail: Cited as UK Parliament Act giving most rights of civil marriage; conversion to marriage from November 2015 noted

leads.title: Marriage and Civil Partnership (Scotland) Act 2014
leads.documents: Legalisation of same-sex marriage in Scotland, religious exemption, commencement dates
leads.detail: Cited as approved Feb 2014, royal assent 12 March 2014, effect 16 Dec 2014, first ceremonies 31 Dec 2014; vote 108-15

leads.title: Equality Act 2010
leads.documents: UK-wide anti-discrimination protection covering sexual orientation, gender reassignment, sex, marriage and civil partnership as applied in Scotland
leads.detail: Cited as 'Equality Act 2010 (Scottish Gaelic: Achd na Co-ionannachd 2010)' outlawing discrimination, harassment and victimisation

leads.title: Gender Recognition Act 2004
leads.documents: Legal gender change mechanism for transgender people in Scotland; basis for later reform debate
leads.detail: Cited as 'Under the Gender Recognition Act 2004, transgender people in Scotland may change their legal gender'

leads.title: Gender Recognition Reform (Scotland) Bill and Scotland Act 1998 Section 35 veto
leads.documents: Scottish reform to lower age to 16 and simplify recognition, passage and UK Government block - key trans-rights enforcement machinery
leads.detail: Cited as passed Dec 2022 by 86-39, applies only to Scotland, awaiting royal assent, overruled by UK government under section 35 of the Scotland Act 1998, first use of that power

leads.title: Hate Crime and Public Order (Scotland) Act - hate crimes bill
leads.documents: Explicit inclusion of sexual orientation and gender identity in hate crime law, commencement and free-speech debate
leads.detail: Cited as introduced April 2020, passed March 2021 by 82-32, royal assent one month later, went into effect 1 April 2024; 2009 penalty-enhancement legislation also noted

leads.title: Scottish Government / National Records of Scotland Census and Scottish Social Attitudes (SSA) statistics
leads.documents: Population data and attitudinal evidence on LGBT status and safety climate: 184,000 LGBT (4%) June 2024, 29% acceptance in 2000 to 59% in 2015, 68% support same-sex marriage 2014
leads.detail: Cited as 'In June 2024 there were almost 184,000 individuals' and SSA polls 2000, 2014, 2015; plus Scottish Government announcements 25 July 2012, 27 June 2013, 2018 X-marker plan
